evals.prompt: Write the YouTube description for the video I just finished.
evals.expected_output: Should resolve the video (video-editor job folder and Notion page), pull the live skeleton with fetch_skeleton.sh --channel from the CLAUDE.md Creator Profile, get the script from collect_script.py or the Notion beat sheet, index the final export with chapter_index.sh and time chapters with find_times.py (rejecting scores under 0.6), follow YouTube's chapter rules, pick links only from references/links.md or flag new ones, use no em dashes, save to descriptions/, and print the raw block in one fenced code block with flags.
assertions: Pulls the skeleton live with fetch_skeleton.sh
Takes chapter timestamps from the final exported file
First chapter is 0:00 with at least 3 chapters
Never invents a URL; new links are flagged
